_help: Hand fixes that survive every data rebuild. Only use facts from the business itself (its website, sign or a message from the owner), OpenStreetMap or a government record, never from review sites, map apps or other directories (see data/SOURCES.md). 'remove': ids to hide. 'patch': id -> fields to change, e.g. {"phone": "(707) 555-0123", "hours": "Mo-Fr 09:00-17:00"}. 'add': whole new listings: name, category, sub, address, zip, phone, website, hours, tags, and 'sources' (where each fact came from). Descriptions are written automatically. Then run: node tools/build-data.mjs final
